scope: Read-only collection of existing test outputs; no engine launched
count_semantics: Exact PASS-line executions, including repeated suites/maps. PNGs and exit-zero summaries are not assertions. Totals remain separate per executable; no claim of complete final-build coverage.
receipt_validation: Collector independently SHA-256 checked both current built/staged executables against the supplied single-hash receipt
source_artifacts: Paths are repository-relative local validation artifacts; some Reports files are ignored by Git. SHA-256 identifies the exact input read. Raw source-group messages are not included.
